posts.title: @naillie_comNaillie — nail art ideas & tested nail products
tutorial_steps: Step 1: Clean, trim and shape nails into your preferred aesthetic contour.
Step 2: Apply a protective base coat to prevent staining and ensure maximum longevity.
Step 3: Apply two smooth, even coats of your primary design color.
Step 4: Add delicate accents, dots or nail art using a precision detailing tool.
Step 5: Seal with a gel-finish glossy top coat to lock in the design for up to 3 weeks.

posts.title: French Tip Nail Ideas
tutorial_steps: Step 1: Shape nails into a graceful almond or squoval contour.
Step 2: Apply two thin coats of sheer pink or milky nude base polish and let dry/cure.
Step 3: Use a fine-tip liner brush (or silicone stamper) to draw the clean smile tip line.
Step 4: Clean up any edges with a flat brush dipped in acetone.
Step 5: Seal with a high-shine plumping top coat for a flawless salon glass finish.
